page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening), one block of running text in full width, no marginal notes. Running head at top left, chapter running head at top centre, page number at top right. Gathering signature at foot centre. A strip of the facing page's outer edge at the left is excluded as neighbouring page edge.

main_text.p: naturalis fundamēto superstructas, ipsius etiam Dei esse, & sub providentiæ Dei generalis actio-nes referendas, salvâque adeò conscientiâ Chri-stianos illis uti & vivere posse affirmamus. Absit verò & hoc, ut magistratus Christiani authorita-tem usque adeò diminutum & suppressam ve-limus, ut leges positivas condere ipsum posse ne-gemus, quæ determinationes, modificationes, expositiones, ampliationes , restrictiones,& ad varias humanæ vitæ, rerum & actionum causas atque casus applicationes, pro populorum, tem-porum & locorum diversitate & ratione , præce-ptis, legibus, sententiis atque gnomis Mosaicis generalibus addunt.

Hanc igitur Philippi & Calvini sententiam recte & uberius Wolfg.Musculus, & Josias Sim-lerus exponunt.Sic enim Musculus in locis com-mu. loco de abrogatione legis Mosaicæ: Judicialia quoq; inquit, cessasse,in eo declaratur,quòd tota Israëlis œconomia,qualè terræ promissæ inhabitatio requirebat, ab eo tempore cessavit, quo expulsi inter gētes, sine rege, sine ducibus, sine sacerdote, & sine lege habitare cœpe-rūt.Simlerus verò in Exod.20. hæc cōmentatur: Politicæ leges,quæ agūt de rebus civilibus,datæ sunt gen-ti Judæorum, ad illam politiam conservandā. Cùm au-tem respub.illa eversa est, aliæ gentes his civilibus legib. non tenentur.Ut enim diversa sunt corporum tempera-menta à diversâ materiâ:ita & leges differunt à gentiū moribus & conditionibus aliis atq; aliis. Aliquæ gentes immanes,barbaræ,non nisi atrocissimis pœnis possunt in officio contineri. Alii magis honesti, & pietatis studiosi sunt,nec opus est tam atrocibus pœnis ad illos coercedos,

page.notes: Left strip of the facing page's outer edge excluded (neighbouring page edge). Doubtful: the italic extent in the quotation from Simlerus/Musculus is approximate, roman "inquit," kept roman. Gathering signature read as "G s" with some uncertainty. Macron and tilde marks over vowels (fundamēto, gētes, cōmentatur, agūt, rūt, conservandā, cœperūt) copied as seen, possibly imprecise. Ampersands written as & to keep the XML valid. Printed spacing before punctuation (e.g. "ampliationes ,", "Sim-lerus exponunt.Sic") kept as printed.
